intro: Somewhere between two stations that no longer exist, the night train stopped. When it started again, every ticket had been replaced with a puzzle. In the sleeper car the passengers settle as they always do: pressing their foreheads to the glass, murmuring the names of places they have left, and folding into their luggage anything the journey has given them that does not fit in a pocket. One woman keeps a tin of ink and a nib, and in the small hours she writes each new thing she finds in her berth onto a card, tucking the card away with the rest, keeping every extra thing she cannot explain. The train rocks on, and the cards grow thick in their box.
echo: Two lines meet, and someone else decides which way you go.
